The supplied runner also changes GPU behavior, database fields, and step limits, so I’ll port only the scheduling and cost tracking pieces. I’m using the repository’s directory, naming, compiling, and verification skills.

The current runner waits for each batch to finish before launching more tests. I’ll use a bounded worker pool so a freed slot can immediately start the next test, with Lua and C tests sharing one cost-sorted queue. The imported timings include step-limited runs, so they’ll serve as initial scheduling estimates until fresh full-run timings are recorded.
